title: STACK COUNTS SIT IN A PILL
why: Seen on the 4K stash screenshots of 2026-10-08: the number on a stacked item (2 bandages, 3 frags) was a bare digit tucked into the rounded corner of the tile, as the equipped gun badge was until v19.96. It sits in a small dark pill now, set in from the corner, so it reads on any picture.
now: The stack counts on stash tiles are easier to read.

edits.anchor:
.cell .cnt{ position:absolute; right:3px; bottom:1px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700;
    color:var(--bone); text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000; pointer-events:none; }
